Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium videogame art director's FULL-SCREEN GAMEPLAY concept for Pantheon: Bloodlines, landscape desktop 16:9, high detail. This is an immersive Greek mythic deckbuilding game, not a website. Reference images: 1 approved Temple card, 2 approved Thaleia leader, 3 approved Athena event, 4 common deck back. Preserve their bronze/laurel frames, cream rules fields, painted art, distinct portrait deck and landscape god/leader shapes. Treat them as card components to integrate, not as layout references.
Art direction: an exquisite tactile obsidian-and-patina strategy table in a moonlit Greek sanctuary, warm gold sunlight at edges, indigo and turquoise enamel, sculptural bronze UI, restrained magical particle light. Actual premium shipped strategy-card videogame screenshot, painterly 3D depth, disciplined visual hierarchy, luxurious and legible, not cluttered ornate fantasy kitsch. Fill the canvas edge to edge. No device mockup, browser chrome, header website, sidebar dashboard, HTML rounded panels, marketing hero, text paragraphs, scrollbars.
Design the active player's complete tactical table: opponent leader medallions and tiny facedown hands along far edge; six compact basic supply piles and twelve compact Action piles occupy the upper playing field, each with cost and separate stock badge; shared landscape god events at the flanks; middle is clear play space with Temple of Athena just played and a subtle golden trajectory, source and destination clear. Along lower edge a beautifully fanned five-card hand with clear titles and tactile cards, common deck-back stack left, public discard right, personal Thaleia landscape leader inset lower left. An ergonomic sculpted resource rail above hand: lightning 2, coin 3, basket 1, altar 2. Phase medallion says "Your turn" and "Actions". Primary sculpted button "To Treasures".
